coverage_notes: Rendered a short-named, byte-identical PDF copy after verifying its SHA-256 against the original. Input fingerprints refer to original supplied bytes. Only listed PDF pages were actually viewed. All 30 entries and 16 CRA rows considered. All registered anchors on PDF pp.2-4 and methods on p.1 visually inspected; Table I distinguishes microstructures on p.2. All original readings retained.
shared_qualifications: C1: Interpret nominal Al-based formula coefficients as atomic proportions; calculate wt.%_i = 100*n_i*M_i/sum(n_j*M_j) over the full formula, not from CSV-filled source values. CIAAW abridged standard atomic weights 2024: Al 26.982, Fe 55.845, Gd 157.25, Ni 58.693, Co 58.933, Ce 140.12 (https://ciaaw.org/abridged-atomic-weights.htm). Nominal converted chemistry is not a measured analysis.
Figures 5-8 report medians with 25th/75th percentiles. Registry min/max retain those percentile roles, not extrema. CRA Avg does not establish a source mean and its blank Min/Max cells are not zero.

Within each alloy family, CRA rows omit heat treatment, microstructure and nanocrystal size. Those missing selectors prevent confirmation of specific source-condition identities; plausible numerical correspondences remain candidates.

Individual Fig.2 scans are not proven to be the same experiments/populations as Figures 5-8 medians. Figures 3-4 annotated metastable-pit events are distinct from the stable, micrometre-scale Epit criterion.
CRA 780 has +980 mV(SCE), outside the registered Al90Fe5Gd5 Epit readings. No sign, decimal or row-order correction is guessed to assign it.

observations.notes: Pure-Al comparator has no chemically matching CRA row. All 16 supplied records contain substantial alloy additions; near potentials do not overcome this material difference. Repeated comparator summaries are not treated as independent experiments.
